title: Columbidae
blurb: Columbidae is a bird family consisting of doves and pigeons. It is the only family in the order Columbiformes.
facts: These are stout-bodied birds with small heads, relatively short necks and slender bills that in some species feature fleshy ceres.
They feed largely on plant matter, feeding on seeds (granivory), fruit (frugivory), and foliage (folivory).
